主要内容: On January 25, 2018, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. appointed Stephen K. Necessary as a director. Mr. Necessary previously served as Executive Vice President, Product Development and Management at Cox Communications, where he directed new development and lifecycle management for products generating over $11 billion in revenue in 2017. He also held the position of Vice President, Video Product Development and Management at Cox Communications from 2005 to 2015. Mr. Necessary will serve as a Class I director, with a term expiring at the 2020 annual meeting. The board determined he meets independence requirements under SEC and NYSE American rules. No related party transactions or arrangements were disclosed for his appointment.
